what: vLLM 0.32.0 serving gpt-oss-20b (openai/gpt-oss-20b safetensors, MXFP4), --enforce-eager --max-model-len 3072, greedy chat completions with top-20 logprobs for 48 prompts (max 200 tokens), sent one at a time and then 16 at once; experiments/vllm_determinism.py. Compared token by token and value by value (positions before any divergence). Runs before 2026-11-01 sent reasoning_effort only in chat_template_kwargs, which vLLM's harmony renderer ignores, so they were made at 'Reasoning: medium'; machine-vs-machine comparisons are unaffected (same rendered prompt everywhere).

default_mode.rtx4090_norway: 1-at-a-time vs 16-at-onc: 45/48 replies diverge; values differ at 4,281/4,334 positions before divergence

batch_invariant_mode (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIA.across the identical group: 0/48 replies diverge, 0/9,493 positions differ, both modes (every pair)
batch_invariant_mode (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIA.H100 PCIe: not batch-invariant on itself (3/48 replies diverge, 384/9,426 positions differ between 1-at-a-time and 16-at-once); differs from the group on 44-45/48 replies
batch_invariant_mode (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIA.RTX 5090: batch-invariant on itself (0/48 replies diverge, 0/9,517 positions differ) but its own group: differs from the Ampere/Ada group and from the H100 on 46/48 replies
batch_invariant_mode (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIA.RTX A6000 (2026-11-01, corrected prompt): batch-invariant on itself (0/48 replies diverge, 0/8,588 positions) and identical to the home RTX 4090 at all 8,588 positions

notes: Ampere and Ada take vLLM's Triton batch-invariant path, Hopper a cuBLAS path (vLLM source, per the research summary in docs/soundness.md); the H100 leak was not traced. Same vLLM, torch and model on every machine; drivers 580-610.

one_pass_referee (prompt_logprobs).what: a referee in batch-invariant mode scoring prompt+reply in one prefill (prompt_logprobs=20) vs the provider's token-by-token logprobs, using the prompt ids vLLM rendered for generation (experiments/vllm_onepass_referee.py)
one_pass_referee (prompt_logprobs).same machine (home RTX 4090): top-20 identical at 8,588/8,588 positions (5 s for 48 replies)
one_pass_referee (prompt_logprobs).home RTX 4090 decode, RTX A6000 prefill: top-20 identical at 8,588/8,588 positions, both the 1-at-a-time and the 16-at-once replies (7 s for 48 replies)
one_pass_referee (prompt_logprobs).conclusion: in batch-invariant mode vLLM's prefill reproduces decode bit for bit, on one machine and across the Ampere/Ada group, so an exact-tier referee can verify a whole reply in one pass
one_pass_referee (prompt_logprobs).retracted_2026-11-01: an earlier entry said prefill differs from decode by >5 nats even on one machine. The prefill prompt came from /tokenize with chat_template_kwargs (Reasoning: low) while generation had run at Reasoning: medium (vLLM's harmony renderer reads only the top-level reasoning_effort); positions 0-2 (the channel header) agreed and the reasoning text diverged from position 3. Not a vLLM effect.

accuracy_of_vllm_decode.what: 48 greedy replies generated by vLLM 0.32 on the user's RTX 4090 (eager) with their returned top-20 logprobs, scored on the same prompt ids (the ones vLLM rendered) and tokens by Hugging Face transformers 5.19 in BF16 (MXFP4 experts dequantized, RTX A6000) and by llama.cpp (lv-engine, RTX 4090) one pass and token by token; experiments/path_noise.py compare
accuracy_of_vllm_decode.conclusion: vLLM's gpt-oss-20b decode on Ada (Marlin MXFP4 MoE, Triton attention) is accurate, somewhat closer to BF16 than llama.cpp's MXFP4 path; batch-invariant mode costs no accuracy
accuracy_of_vllm_decode.retracted_2026-11-01: an earlier entry reported 12.5% different top tokens and MAE 0.26 vs BF16 (11.7% vs llama.cpp in default mode) and called vLLM's decode inaccurate. The vLLM replies had been generated at 'Reasoning: medium' (chat_template_kwargs ignored by the harmony renderer) and the references scored them after a 'Reasoning: low' system prompt, so the gap measured the prompt difference. MoE backend checks made before the cause was found (marlin 12.1%, emulation 14.7% vs llama.cpp) carry the same mismatch.
